sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com) pages and spell lists, read through WebSearch summaries only: the wiki host is not reachable from the build machine (the search summaries name the pages and quote their descriptions).
sources.ja_search: Japanese pages found by WebSearch (ja.wikipedia.org Black Clover article, manga-tantei.com character articles, pixiv encyclopedia, ja.namu.wiki spell list, bclover.jp character files): Japanese spell names and one-line effects, read through search summaries only.
sources.design: Order of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs (the exact chapter or episode of most spells was not confirmed): see docs/magic/character_spells_gold.md.

spells.name: Steel Magic: (the book's first page)
spells.note: Mode 0 of the Steel book; shown because the engine never hides mode 0. Not a named wiki spell.

spells.name: Steel Magic: Blazing Piercing Lance
spells.note: A great lance of steel launched at the target (the Japanese article names it his attack lance).

spells.name: Steel Magic: Steel Castle's Armored Wall
spells.note: A wall of steel raised from the ground; his defensive spell.

spells.name: Steel Magic: Violent Spiral Lance
spells.note: A spiralling lance that drills through its target (the English wiki spelling varies: Blazing Spiral Lance, Fierce Spiral Lance).

spells.name: Thunder Arrow (union with Luck Voltia's lightning and Puli's wing magic)
spells.note: The English Steel Magic page lists it as a union spell; the Japanese article puts it in the Royal Knights Selection Exam, a super-fast attack that is hard to steer after it is shot.
